text:
Terrible service, terrible communication.

My partner and I went in for a general checkup and clean a month ago, the experience was very poor. Charge $1500 Bhat for an xray she did not ask for. When it was delivered at the counter it had the wrong name on it and displayed as male not female. The dentist did not come and explain anything on the xray, it was left up to an unqualified receptionist to explain the details of the xray.

I was booked in for a month later, thought I would go back and give them a second chance. They had not sent the confirmation text message to the right place neither did they explain this when we were in there for the original appointment. Did not make an effort to contact me to see if I was coming in.

Turned up today, the receptionist explained that my appointment had not been confirmed when asked why I didn’t receive a text she said that it was sent on line to my partners number. Strange path of communication considering you had my details.

Highly do not recommend. Even when we explained our issues there was no assurance to make it right, just blank faces.

Do not recommend, save your self the time and money and go elsewhere.

text: Good service, doctor is nice and professional, price is a bit high but worth it
I went to have my wisdom tooth extracted. All the staff were very polite and helpful. The clinic accepts social security insurance. The doctor is skilled and gave good advice.
How much does Damon braces cost? And how much does regular braces cost?
The doctor was very polite and some of the staff were excellent, speaking kindly and friendly.
The clinic provided excellent care. The staff were friendly and welcoming.

The staff was so unfriendly and untrained. I asked about fillings, and they held up a price list, but there were no fillings on it. Then I asked about filling prices, and they told me 2,000-4,000 baht. I wanted to see the doctor, and they charged me 500 baht for that. I'm insured and will get everything reimbursed, but I felt like a penniless beggar and decided to leave. The business-damaging receptionists didn't even say goodbye.
The doctor has a gentle hand. The staff are very kind and lovely.
The service staff were excellent, polite, and attentive.
Fast service, lovely doctor, and welcoming staff.
I'm very happy with the teeth whitening results. I didn't experience any tooth sensitivity.
The staff were so lovely and spoke so politely.
